title: Iterated extended machine steps
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, let $P$ be a finite program of extended instructions, and let $x$ and $\rho$ be finite Boolean input and coin tapes. For configurations $c$ and $c'$, the relation of taking $n$ steps holds when, for $n=0$, $c=c'$, and for $n+1$, one step from $c$ returns a configuration $c_1$ rather than a halting result, and $c_1$ takes the remaining $n$ steps to $c'$.
